label: Movement
tooltip: Mounting, sprinting, and unsticking for all travel (Illegal Mode, Treasure Hunt, Carrot Hunt, Mob Farmer).

should_auto_mount.label: Mount while traveling
should_auto_mount.tooltip:
On: mount for long travel and remount if you dismount mid-route (Illegal Mode, Treasure Hunt, Carrot Hunt, Mob Farmer).
Off: stay on foot unless something else mounts you.

should_jump_when_stuck.label: Jump when stuck
should_jump_when_stuck.tooltip: When movement stalls on rocks, ledges, or stairs.

jump_when_stuck_seconds.label: Seconds before jumping
jump_when_stuck_seconds.tooltip: How long to stand still before trying a jump.

enable_path_conflict_detection.label: Enable path conflict detection
enable_path_conflict_detection.tooltip: Check for other players on our active path and re-route if someone is ahead of us.

path_conflict_check_interval_seconds.label: Conflict check interval (seconds)
path_conflict_check_interval_seconds.tooltip: Minimum time between path conflict checks.

path_conflict_distance_threshold.label: Conflict distance threshold (meters)
path_conflict_distance_threshold.tooltip: Another player within this distance of any path waypoint is considered "on our path".

path_conflict_ahead_threshold.label: Conflict ahead threshold (meters)
path_conflict_ahead_threshold.tooltip: How much closer to the destination the other player must be to trigger a re-route. Prevents re-routing for players behind us or alongside us.
